question: In which of the following cities in the United States of America, Yugantar Ashram, the headquarter of the Gadar Party, a liberation movement of India, was established?
solution:
The correct answer is __**San Francisco.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **original name of the Ghadar Party was Pacific Coast Hindustan Association.**
 
• The founding** chairman of the Ghadar Party was Sohan Singh Bhakna** and Lala Hardayal was the co-founder of this party.
 
• Headquarters of the movement were set up at Yugantar Ashram in **San Francisco.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Gadar Party:**

 
 
• The Ghadar Movement was an important occasion in India’s freedom struggle.
 
• A boat named Komagatamaru, filled with Indian emigrants was turned back from Canada.
 
• As the boat returned to India several of its passengers were killed or arrested in a clash with the British police.
 
• This incident made the Ghadar Party annunciate the war and inspired thousands of Indian emigrants to come back and organize a fortified rebellion against British imperialism.
 
• still, this movement was crushed.
 
• This composition deals with the important events of the Ghadar Movement.
